title: capture re-runs the full suite when the same phase already holds a green entry at the current tree
detail: engine-agents-linked: operator captured the full suite --phase regression from the solo worktree (exit 0, 4559). regression-sentinel then ran the same capture command, same phase, same tree; reuse (0.262.0) excludes the phase's own earlier entries, so it re-ran the identical suite (~300s) for an identical result. Either a same-phase same-tree green entry short-circuits, or the trivial-lane flow should capture under solo_execute so the sentinel reuses.
